content.title: PTC Q3 Deep Dive: Divestiture Sharpens Focus on Core Lifecycle Solutions
content.summary: Product design software company PTC (NASDAQ:PTC) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 42.7% year on year to $893.8 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $630 million was less impressive, coming in 1.4% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.47 per share was 52.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
